In the upper half, a young woman with long dark hair smiles while holding a glowing neon sign in a dark, crowded stadium environment. The bottom half shows a young man with dark hair and a white t-shirt standing on a simple indoor stage, holding a microphone and singing with a white projection screen behind him. (2) As the song progresses, the city names on the neon sign in the top frame change rapidly, displaying 'Shanghai', 'Handan', and 'Tokyo'. The man in the bottom frame reacts with physical energy, pointing at the camera and shouting the city names in time with the music, while his facial expressions show high engagement and occasional comedic emphasis. (3) The sequence continues with more difficult city names like 'Bozhou' and 'Buenos Aires'. The man appears to struggle playfully, correcting himself and maintaining a frantic singing pace. The background on the stage is dimly lit with a yellow stool visible to his left, emphasizing the low-budget, comedic nature of the performance. (4) In the final phase, a map silhouette of Kaohsiung appears on the neon sign. The man shows exaggerated confusion, scratching his head and looking around the stage before finally shouting the correct name as the video ends. The lighting remains a mix of the bright stadium glow on top and soft indoor stage lighting on the bottom.
